description: This file defines the exception class 'LoanRepaymentScheduleNotFoundException' used in the loan account module of the Fineract project. It extends an abstract exception class and provides constructors for different scenarios where a loan repayment schedule is not found.

classes.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleNotFoundException
classes.description: An exception indicating that a loan repayment schedule could not be found for a given identifier.

methods.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleNotFoundException(Integer id)
methods.description: Constructor for creating an exception when an installment ID is invalid.

methods.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleNotFoundException(Long id)
methods.description: Constructor for creating an exception when a repayment ID is invalid.

methods.name: LoanRepaymentScheduleNotFoundException(Long id, Integer loan)
methods.description: Constructor for when a loan does not have a repayment schedule for a given loan ID.
